items.description: A flaw has been found in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /usr/sbin/restore_config.cgi. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor

Incomplete cleanup during VMRUN error handling could allow access to a Secure Encrypted Virtualization-Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP) guest register state, potentially resulting in information disclosure and impacts to confidentiality.

Improper verification of a cryptographic signature in the PSP Boot ROM of AMD Zeppelin (Zen1/Zen+) processors could allow an attacker with local access to the SPI flash to bypass secure boot authentication, potentially resulting in arbitrary unsigned code execution at full Platform Security Processo
Improper address validation in the AMD RAID Configuration Driver could allow an attacker with administrative access to read arbitrary kernel memory, potentially resulting in loss of confidentiality.

Insufficient Granularity of Access Control in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow a malicious hypervisor to potentially redirect accesses to MMIO memory resulting in loss of guest memory integrity.

A vulnerability was detected in eigent-ai eigent up to 1.0.2. Improper input validation within the AmdPlatformRasSmm driver could allow an attacker with privileged access to overwrite SMRAM, potentially resulting in arbitrary code execution.
